primary.title: Prop. 4 clears a path for public campaign money. It does not spend any.
primary.summary: Proposition 4 would lift California's ban on public financing of campaigns and leave the size of any future program to later governments.

primary.title: Ring is deliberately nefarious when you E2E encrypt your video
primary.summary: I turned on Ring's End-to-End Encryption for a bit more privacy. Previews vanished, recordings broke and answering the door stopped working. Here's what happened.

primary.title: Confessions of a Middle-Aged Domain Hoarder
primary.summary: I personally own well over 100 domains. A select few of them are actually live. The rest? Parked, forwarded, or none of the above. These domains cost me real money. For whatever reason, I've chosen to be loyal to a domain registrar that doesn't have the best prices, unless you jump through some weird hoops with their discount program.
